prompt:
## Objective
Give olin's port of action_policy and validate_export a frozen error-code contract, completing BEI-131 decision D11: 'the trio ships one error-code contract'.

## Design summary
- Reality check (audited in-session): neither script has stable codes today. action_policy.py raises free-text via SystemExit at 19 sites; validate_export.py appends free-text at 26 sites. So this slice mints codes first, then catalogs.
- Code minting: snake_case codes in the established normalizer style (D11: 'Keep the existing code style'). One code per distinct failure CLASS - multiple sites sharing a meaning share a code. Audit each site; resolve duplicate-meaning or inconsistent messages before freezing (ticket acceptance).
- Emission format: prepend the code to the existing message - '<code>: <human text>'. Preserve exit-code semantics and the human text; downstream consumers grep these messages, so verify with a repo-wide grep that nothing parses the exact old strings before changing them (pause if something does).
- Catalog: extend docs/parser-conformance.md with two sibling sections ('action_policy error codes', 'validate_export error codes') using the exact existing 4-column table: | code | severity | when emitted | path convention |. Every cataloged code must exist in the implementation - no aspirational entries.
- Conformance-corpus pinning for the two tools: only if trivial; otherwise state the follow-up in the final report per the ticket.
- Extend the script-harness tests to assert the code-prefixed format for a representative sample of failure classes per script.

## File scope
Include: scripts/action_policy.py, scripts/validate_export.py, docs/parser-conformance.md, existing script tests. Exclude: workflow_normalizer and its frozen catalog rows.

## Constraints
The catalog freezes once shipped - correctness over speed. Beislid auto-releases on push; this slice does NOT push (human close-out). No remote writes.

## Verification
grep -q 'action_policy' docs/parser-conformance.md && grep -q 'validate_export' docs/parser-conformance.md
python3 scripts/validate_skills.py
bash scripts/validate.sh  # pre-PR local CI mirror, expensive - run once before handoff
